claims: "One Shining Moment" airs on CBS approximately 25–30 minutes after the conclusion of the NCAA Men's Basketball National Championship game.
"One Shining Moment" sets tournament highlights to music.
"One Shining Moment" usually follows the championship game on a Monday night.
The song for "One Shining Moment" is performed by Luther Vandross.
The song for "One Shining Moment" closes out the NCAA tournament coverage late Monday night/early Tuesday morning following the final game.
The 2026 "One Shining Moment" montage was released in the early hours of April 7.
"One Shining Moment" was created by David Barrett in 1986.
"One Shining Moment" was originally intended for the Super Bowl.
"One Shining Moment" became the definitive March Madness highlight reel in 1987.
"One Shining Moment" can be viewed on the NCAA March Madness YouTube channel.
"One Shining Moment" can be viewed through the March Madness Live portal.
"One Shining Moment" highlights key moments from the entire tournament.
"One Shining Moment" ends with the champions' celebration.
